visualCharacteristics.summary: Filterable credit-card catalogue: category tabs (optional icons), a live "Showing N Cards" count, and a grid of cards (image, title, bullet list, Know More / Apply Now CTAs) filtered client-side by category.

contentPattern.structure: Optional intro row; optional tabs row [Filters | tab | tab ...]; optional count row "Showing {count} Cards"; one card per row [image | title + list + links | comma-separated categories].

usage: Filterable credit-card catalogue: category tabs (optional icons), a live "Showing N Cards" count, and a grid of cards (image, title, bullet list, Know More / Apply Now CTAs) filtered client-side by category.

suitableFor: product catalogues filtered by category tabs
notSuitableFor: contact or lead forms (the report-a-fraud instance is a form, not a card finder)
